name: Git Plugin
description: Full-featured Git client plugin (~1050 lines). Left panel: Branch/Remote selectors, staged/unstaged changes sections (expandable headers with counts, per-file stage/unstage buttons), commit message input + Commit/Push buttons, commits list (clickable, shows hash+message+author+date). Right panel (split-pane with horizontal divider): commit info header (hash, author, date, subject, description), changed files tree (from git diff-tree), and diff viewer. Diff viewer supports unified and side-by-side modes (dropdown toggle). Unified mode renders git diff output with syntax-colored lines (diff-meta, diff-hunk, diff-add, diff-remove). Side-by-side mode pairs old/new lines from unified diff, including replace detection (adjacent -/+ pairs). Resizable: left panel width (120-600px) and top/bottom panel height (40px min). Debounced auto-refresh on file changes (1s). State serialization: selectedCommitHash, selectedFilePath, diffViewMode, leftColWidth, topPanelHeight, changesExpanded. Supports applyLayout for instant splitter size restore, then async restoreState for data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Full reload: remotes, branches, commits, staged/unstaged files

methods.name: refreshChanges
methods.description: Lightweight refresh: only reload staged/unstaged files, preserve commit state

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serialize selection, view mode, and splitter sizes
